perf.scheduledNote: Time between failures uses the scheduled production hours set for each machine.

workbook.fresh: Built {{when}} · {{size}} KB. Same columns as the register you already use.

setup.title: Machine setup
setup.subtitle: Three answers the dashboard is waiting for. Each one switches on a number that is currently held back.
setup.pricedLabel: Machines with an hourly downtime cost
setup.allOrNothing: Both need every machine before they count. A cost total covering half the plant looks complete and is silently low, so it is withheld until all of them have a rate — and availability stays on calendar hours until every machine has a schedule.
setup.bulkNote: Most of a plant shares one schedule. Set them all here, then correct the exceptions in the table below.
setup.savedNote: Saved as you leave each box. There is no Save button — a half-finished session keeps what you typed.
